rows.note: For an ordinary person who spends a lot of time thinking, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: My sister is always sitting there thinking; she’s a thinker.
example.traditional: 我妹成日坐喺度諗嘢，係個諗嘢嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui6 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 dou6 nam2 je5 hai6 go3 nam2 je5 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a recognised intellectual or philosopher rather than merely someone who thinks a lot.

example.english: This thinker has many original views on freedom.
example.traditional: 呢位思想家對自由有好多獨到見解。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 si1 soeng2 gaa1 deoi3 zi6 jau4 jau5 hou2 do1 duk6 dou3 gin3 gaai2

rows.note: Use this when “thinker” is slang for someone’s mind or brain, as in “use your thinker.”

example.english: Use your thinker and don’t ask everyone everything.
example.traditional: 用下你個腦，唔好乜都問人。
example.jyutping: jung6 haa5 nei5 go3 nou5 m4 hou2 mat1 dou1 man6 jan4
